findings.passage: “No. 1 with the election reform is instituting voter ID, signature verification and the elimination of drop boxes,” Mustello said.
findings.note: Quoted by the Butler Eagle (article by Eddie Trizzino, dated May 2, 2022, before the May 17, 2022 primary). She names voter ID, signature verification and removing drop boxes as her top election reform.

findings.passage: “Pennsylvanians must be able to trust the election process and results of our elections. I support the Voting Rights Protection Act, which includes, among many other things, provisions to tighten security by expanding voter identification requirements, requiring regular election audits, banning ballot harvesting and allowing public access to review ballots after an election,” Mustello said.
findings.note: Quoted by the Butler Eagle (Steve Ferris, Jan 17, 2022). She says she supports the Voting Rights Protection Act and names its voter identification expansion, audits, ballot-harvesting ban and public ballot review.

findings.passage: “We want to give confidence to people that their votes are being counted. Believe me, every vote counts,” she said.
findings.note: Quoted by the Butler Eagle in the same Jan 17, 2022 profile. General statement about voter confidence in election results.
